# DynamicAppearDisappearPage: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on this page that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `DynamicAppearDisappearElements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## In the page

- **"Show element"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `SHOW_ELEMENT_BUTTON`: `click().showElement()`.
- **"Load slowly"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `LOAD_SLOWLY_BUTTON`: `click().loadSlowly()`.
- **"Start loading"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `START_LOADING_BUTTON`: `click().startLoading()`.
- **"Save draft"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `SAVE_DRAFT_BUTTON`: `click().saveDraft()`.
- **"Remove element"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `REMOVE_ELEMENT_BUTTON`: `click().removeElement()`.
- **"Hide element"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `HIDE_ELEMENT_BUTTON`: `click().hideElement()`.
- **"Reset both"**: button. In `DynamicAppearDisappearElements` as `RESET_BOTH_BUTTON`: `click().resetBoth()`.
